title: Influence of material properties on rate of resorption of two bone graft materials after sinus lift using radiographic assessment
supports: TIER 4 WHEN SPOKEN EXTERNALLY. The published, Medical Affairs approved reference behind the deck statement that cerabone shows significantly less volumetric loss than Bio-Oss.
